facts.value: Revision 4 on plugin/plugin-marketplace replaces the earlier save-and-import flow. Enabling the marketplace fetches its missing GitHub descriptors. On BCM_API36_CachyOS the updated GitHub APK fetched the missing groups, displayed DLsite-fetch as checked and inactive while its parent was off, and preserved all four switch positions after re-enabling. Two isolated Android lifecycle tests passed, including removal/re-download, offline retry, process restoration and late fetch cancellation. GitHub and Play debug/release builds, debug unit tests and lint completed.

The fifth GitHub plugin, Reverse Image Discovery, activates SauceNAO and IQDB. Play retains its existing reverse-image features. Verified all five installed cards on the API 36 emulator. facts.value: On the GitHub marketplace branch, an empty catalogue offers Open Plugins. The Plugins tab has instructions for the marketplace and compatible custom descriptors. The API 36 emulator opened the Plugins tab from the empty catalogue notice and displayed both tutorials. Both debug editions built, their debug unit suites passed, and the platform-groups device test passed. The import tutorial identifies marketplace.bcmplugin as the marketplace setup file and gives the path from the bottom Plugins tab to Documents/BookCoverMatcher/Plugins in shared storage. The plugin picker requests this initial folder and allows selecting files elsewhere.
